messages:
maria.dev: Quick async — API gateway check-in.
What I did: landed tenant-scoped routing policy merge + tests for prefix/method matching.
Blockers: seeing 5xx spikes in the canary from lambda-proxy routes; looks related to rate-limit header parsing.
Today: rolling canary back to 10% while I debug; will push a patch to normalise headers. pinging @tyler_s for a quick CR.

tyler_s: :eyes: I'll take a look now. Can you paste the log lines you're seeing?

maria.dev: logs:
```
2026-03-16T14:22:11Z ERROR gateway.proxy: failed to parse X-Rate-Limit='20/60' for tenant=acme
2026-03-16T14:22:12Z WARN gateway.handler: upstream 502 from lambda-proxy id=xyz
```
I think the parser chokes on the slash format; older services use tokens like "20/60" and newer expect JSON.

dmitri: saw this in staging yesterday. The auth-proxy lowercases headers which broke the new parser. I have a small patch that normalizes header casing and tolerates both formats. Can we try it on the canary?

maria.dev: adding your patch in 5m. will monitor.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: maria.dev/routing-header-normalize -> canary (10%)
ops-bot: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcdef/gateway?from=now-1h to check 5xx and RT

sara-k: FYI I've suppressed the noisy rate-limit alert (95th) for the canary window. CC @ajay for the routing-schema update.

ajay: ack. I'll run the integration suite against the new routing-schema and the header-normalize patch. If green, we can bump canary to 30%.

tyler_s: quick CR comment: prefer `parseRateLimit` to accept both `20/60` and `{"limit":20,"window":60}`. small nit.

maria.dev: good call. I'll update tests. ETA EOD. Thanks team :thumbsup:
